reason: I fill my nights with my PR people, the WhatsApp lists and the regulars, and a new app with no users yet doesn't change that. Every other club in the area can pay the same money and get the same top spot, so I don't see what I gain.
objection: My competitors will be on it too, so what do I gain? Nobody uses it yet, and I'd be paying 250 a month for the promise of an audience that doesn't exist.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of real students opening it in my area, like a few thousand active users in Trieste, Udine or Padova, and a way to get exclusive placement over rival clubs in my town. A pay-per-ticket-sold deal with no monthly fee would also do it.
